policies: Cancellation Policy: You must cancel your reservation the day before by 5:00pm for a full refund.
If no-show on day of rental, the full charge for the boat(s) reserved will be applied to the credit card.
Foul weather is determined by marina staff based on a combination of real time observations and National Weather Service predictions.
Do not assume the local TV weather report is accurate, call marina for official foul weather determination.
Isolated / unforeseen rain encountered during the time a rental boat is being used is not a reason for discount or refund.
A no-show is considered over one hour late for a half day rental or over two hours late for a full day rental.
